snippet.title: Rock On Raccoon! Trailer
snippet.description:
Rocky and his friends are aspiring rock stars that live in the garage of a human house. One day, the humans adopt a group of jazz-playing cats that kick out the raccoons. Now, they have to hone their skills against other animal bands to have a shot at winning the big animal band battle, or else they will have to live on the streets!

Free to download and play on iOS and Android.

--- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rock-on-raccoon/id6450372557
--- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MassDiGI.TeamCottonCandy
